messages:
ana-partnerships: FYI — Falkirk (eu-west-7) partner kickoff. Atlas Systems wants to onboard their SI workload + enable our edge SKU in that region. Can we get a quick sync on quotas, KMS, and timeline? :wave:
sahil-cloud: Nice, do we have the initial quota numbers from Atlas? they mentioned ~8 reserved GPUs to start + burst to 16 during peak tests.@alex-atlas can you confirm?
alex-atlas: Confirmed — initial commitment 8 A100-equivalent, burst to 16 during load tests. Need marketplace SKU enabled and a shared KMS path for customer keys.
jordan-partner-eng: Two integration asks: (1) marketplace SKU listing + entitlements, (2) onboarding checklist for Atlas SI agents (we provide an agent container). Need sample manifest and network ports.
kevin-ops: For quotas I'll open the cloud ticket. Can someone drop the exact quota lines I can paste? prefer `project, region, sku, desired_count` format.
nana-partnerships: (typo) meant ana-partnerships :sweat_smile:
maria-legal: Heads up — need an approved data processing addendum for Atlas SI access to logs before we enable Private VPC routes. I'm ok to fast-track but need sign-off by EOD Tue.
olivia-sales: Sales has one pilot customer lined up for June 2. Can we aim to have canary capacity + marketplace SKU by May 28 so we can schedule the demo?
chen-sre: Canaries: suggest a 3-stage rollout: dev (2 GPUs), canary (4 GPUs), prod (8 GPUs). We should run perf/e2e tests at each stage and keep a rollback tag. Will need a maintenance window for kernel updates.
sahil-cloud: Quota snippet — paste & confirm: 
```
project: redwood-prod
region: eu-west-7
sku: redwood-edge-a100
requested: 16
notes: initial 8 reserved, burst to 16 for tests
```
kevin-ops: thanks, filing ticket now. ETA for response from cloud partner is usually 48-72h. I'll add priority flag and link back here.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] quota-request #4231 created by kevin-ops — https://ticketing.internal/4231
jordan-partner-eng: KMS — we need a shared multi-tenant design: Atlas wants customer-managed keys for pilot customers. Can we support envelope encryption with their KMS?@sahil-cloud
sahil-cloud: Yes, we support envelope keys. Need Atlas service account and KMS key ARN. Also confirm whether their KMS is AWS KMS or a partner HSM (they mentioned Azure Key Vault sometimes).
alex-atlas: We'll provide AWS KMS ARNs for the pilot, and a technical contact for HSM if customer asks.
maria-legal: I'll review the AMP + SI access clauses today. If any redlines, I will flag inline in the doc.
chen-sre: Network note — the agent container requires outbound to `storage.redwood.ai:443` and inbound on TCP 4500 from our ops IPs. Add to onboarding manifest.
jordan-partner-eng: Manifest snippet for onboarding agent (for tests): 
```
image: redwood/atlas-agent:stable
ports:
  - 4500:4500/tcp
env:
  - REDWOOD_API=https://api.redwood.ai
  - AGENT_MODE=si
```
olivia-sales: Great. I'll tell the pilot customer we target May 28 canary + June 2 demo. If legal signs off earlier we can move up. :crossed_fingers:
kevin-ops: Added a scheduled maintenance window proposal: May 25 02:00-06:00 UTC for kernel + node prep. Is that ok for Atlas?@alex-atlas
alex-atlas: May 25 window works. We'll coordinate our engineers to avoid overlap with their customer testing.
nana-partnerships: again, sorry for the earlier typo, ignore :grimacing:
maria-legal: Uploaded preliminary DPA draft to /legal/partnerships/atlas-dpa-draft.docx — please comment by EOD.
chen-sre: I'll spin up dev canary cluster on May 10 to validate agent & perf. Invite kevin + jordan to the runbook.
jordan-partner-eng: Putting runbook checklist in shared doc now — will share link shortly.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] runbook created: https://runbooks.internal/r/atlas-falkirk-onboard
ana-partnerships: (really fixing name) ana-partnerships: Next actions: 1) kevin file quota (done) 2) maria legal review (in progress) 3) saahil confirm KMS ARNs from Atlas 4) chen run canary May 10 5) jordan publish manifest & runbook. Ping me if any blockers.
sahil-cloud: ack — will ask Alex for ARNs today.
kevin-ops: I'll post ticket link & status updates here when I hear back from cloud partner.
olivia-sales: Thanks all — will prep customer comms once canary passes.
chen-sre: one last note — please ensure monitoring alerts include token-level cost burn for the pilot routes. We want to avoid surprise spend.
nana-partnerships: ana-partnerships: noted. Closing loop later today with a summary. :white_check_mark:
